```{r setup}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")
library("kableExtra")
library("Seurat")

pal_discrete_sc <- palette_discrete()[-7]

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)
path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "qc_integration")

source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))
# new_ident <- "predicted.labels"
# old_ident <- "RNA_snn_res.0.35"
new_ident <- "RNA_snn_res.0.35"
old_ident <- "old_labels"
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path, "type_integrated.rda"))
seurat <- reorder_idents(seurat, new_ident)
seurat <- subsampling_sc(seurat)
seurat_old <- seurat
plot_dim(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc)
```

```{r, fig.height = 2, fig.width = 2}
plot_dim(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc, alpha = .1, label.size = 8) + 
  NoLegend() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )
```

## UMAP per Type

```{r}
  idents = new_ident
)

bar_group_ident(
  seurat,

  idents = new_ident,

)
```



## Cell per cluster
```{r}
seurat <- subset(
    seurat_old, 
    subset = Type == "WT"
)

seurat <- reorder_idents(seurat, old_ident)
plot_dim(
    seurat, 
    split.by = old_ident,
    col = pal_discrete_sc,
    pt.size = .25,
    ncol = 4,
    label = FALSE
) + NoLegend()

Idents(seurat) <- new_ident
plot_dim(
    seurat, 
    split.by = new_ident,
    col = pal_discrete_sc,
    pt.size = .25,
    ncol = 4,
    label = FALSE
) + NoLegend()
```

```{r, fig.height = 2, fig.width = 2}
tmp <- reorder_idents(seurat, y = old_ident)
plot_dim(tmp, cols = pal_discrete_sc, alpha = .1, label.size = 8) + 
    NoLegend() +
    theme(
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
    )
```
  
```{r}
plot_dim(tmp, cols = pal_discrete_sc)
seurat <- reorder_idents(seurat, new_ident)
seurat_old <- seurat
plot_dim(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc)
```

## Misclassified
```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 12}
l_seurat <- list.map(
    levels(Idents(seurat)),
    f(x) ~ {
      res <- subset(seurat, idents = x)
      Idents(res) <- old_ident
      return(res)
    }
)

p <- list.map(
    l_seurat,
    f(x, y, z) ~ plot_dim(x, pt.size = 1) +
      ggtitle(z)
)

plot_grid(plotlist = p, ncol = 3, nrow = 2, align = "hv")
plot_grid(plotlist = p[8:length(p)], ncol = 3, nrow = 2, align = "hv")
```

```{r}
tmp <- list.map(
    l_seurat,
    f(x, y, z) ~cluster_size(Idents(x))  %>%
     rbind("Total" = c(n = colSums(.[, "n", drop = FALSE]), freq = "")) %>% 
        rownames_to_column(var = "Group") %>%
        mutate(Cluster = z)
    ) %>%
     list_rbind()


cluster_counts <- tmp %>% 
  count(Cluster) %>% 
  pull(n)

group_names <- paste("Cluster", unique(tmp$Cluster))

p <- tmp %>% 
    select(-Cluster) %>%
    kable_sc()  %>%
  pack_rows(
    index = setNames(cluster_counts, group_names),
    label_row_css = "background-color: #666; color: #fff;"
  )
save_kable(
    p,
    file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cells.png"),
    zoom = 2
)
p
```
